_README: This is your shop. Edit the list below and refresh the page - no code needed. 'price' is just text, so '$24' or '$24 - $30' or 'Made to order' all work. Leave 'etsy_url' as "" and the button says 'Email me about these' and takes people to your contact form. Put a real link in and it turns into 'Buy on Etsy' by itself. Set 'sold_out' to true to show a Sold Out ribbon. To hide a piece entirely, delete its block.
